evals.prompt: I want to build a new PPTB tool.
evals.expected_output: Should check the working directory for an existing PPTB tool (package.json with displayName/main/icon and @pptb/types in devDependencies) as the first decision. Since no files exist at all, should conclude this is a new tool and hand off to create-pptb-tool.
assertions: Makes the create-pptb-tool vs update-pptb-tool decision before anything else
Detects that no existing PPTB project is present
Hands off to create-pptb-tool, not update-pptb-tool

evals.prompt: Add error handling to my tool.
evals.expected_output: Should detect displayName/main/icon in package.json plus @pptb/types in devDependencies, conclude this is an existing tool, and hand off to update-pptb-tool. Should NOT jump straight to add-error-handling without going through update-pptb-tool first, even though the requested capability is unambiguous.
assertions: Detects the existing manifest fields and @pptb/types dependency
Hands off to update-pptb-tool rather than create-pptb-tool
Does not jump directly to add-error-handling, skipping the create-vs-update decision
Does not attempt to re-scaffold the project

evals.prompt: Set up a new PPTB tool for me.
evals.expected_output: Even though the prompt uses 'set up a new tool' wording, the directory already contains a fully-formed PPTB manifest. Should trust the file-based detection over the prompt's wording, conclude this is an existing tool, and hand off to update-pptb-tool instead of re-scaffolding over the existing project.
assertions: Does not take 'new' in the prompt at face value without checking the working directory
Detects the existing manifest fields and @pptb/types dependency
Hands off to update-pptb-tool rather than create-pptb-tool
Does not overwrite or re-scaffold the existing project

evals.prompt: Help me finish setting up this tool.
evals.expected_output: package.json has displayName and main, but is missing icon and has no devDependencies at all (so @pptb/types isn't present). Both conditions (manifest fields AND @pptb/types) must be true to count as an existing tool, so this should be treated as an incomplete/new project. Should hand off to create-pptb-tool to finish the scaffold, not update-pptb-tool.
assertions: Recognizes that the existing-tool check requires both manifest fields and @pptb/types to be true
Does not treat a partially-filled package.json as sufficient evidence of an existing tool
Hands off to create-pptb-tool rather than update-pptb-tool
Does not incorrectly report the project as already scaffolded

evals.prompt: I need to bump the version of my tool and publish an update.
evals.expected_output: Should detect this as an existing tool and hand off to update-pptb-tool, which is responsible for routing a version-bump-and-republish request to npm version plus validate-pptb-tool and publish-pptb-tool. Should not treat this as a scaffolding task.
assertions: Detects the existing manifest fields and @pptb/types dependency
Hands off to update-pptb-tool for a version bump request, not create-pptb-tool
Does not attempt to scaffold a new project for what is clearly a maintenance task
